backdrop_throne_v2._note: Native 768x256 backdrop composited from two wall modules by tools/compose-throne-backdrop.mjs — see docs/ART_PIPELINE.md §9.5. full_hall_reference was a whole-room attempt kept only as a style_asset_id for the two modules (aspect ratio couldn't match the 3:1 room, see §9.5 upload note).

full_hall_reference.note: not used directly — wrong aspect ratio for a 3:1 room; kept only as style reference

wall_anchored._note: Wall textures anchored (style_asset_ids) to the window/curtain modules, so backdrop walls share their actual material — see docs/ART_PIPELINE.md §9.10. Used via fillWallTexture() in the throne/chapel compositors; NOT used as discrete 16x16 game tiles (that attempt was noisy, reverted).

castle_purple.note: no explicit color forced — native tone already matches the castle stone ramp; used in chapel

tower_green.note: colors explicitly forced to TOWER_RAMP hex; used in throne

history._note: Dead experiments kept for provenance only; nothing here is live.

tile_bgWall_phase2_attempts._note: Two cold-start generations (too bright, invented arches; then a plain-tile version that passed alone) plus a third anchored-but-noisy crop-into-16x16 attempt — all reverted. See docs/ART_PIPELINE.md §9.8 and §9.10.
